description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyPermissionUtil class, which provides utility methods for managing and targeting runtime permissions for the Android 'monkey' testing tool. It includes functionality for identifying relevant permissions, mapping permissions to packages, and generating random permission events for testing purposes.

classes.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
classes.description: A utility class for handling runtime permission operations specifically tailored for the Android 'monkey' testing bot, including permission filtering, mapping, and event generation.

methods.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing the permission manager interfaces.

methods.name: setTargetSystemPackages
methods.description: Sets whether system packages should be targeted during permission testing.

methods.name: shouldTargetPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package should be included in permission testing based on filtering and system app status.

methods.name: shouldTargetPermission
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission should be targeted based on its group and protection level.

methods.name: populatePermissionsMapping
methods.description: Builds a mapping of targeted packages to their relevant permissions.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the list of targeted packages and their permissions for debugging.

methods.name: generateRandomPermissionEvent
methods.description: Creates a random permission event for the monkey testing tool based on the current permission mappings.
